description: This Java source file defines the QueueAdapter class, which is an ArrayAdapter that manages and displays a list of MediaSession.QueueItem objects within a list view, including handling visual indication of the active queue item.

classes.name: QueueAdapter
classes.description: A custom list adapter for displaying media queue items with an indication of the currently active item.

classes.name: ViewHolder
classes.description: A static inner class used to cache views for list item layout to optimize performance.

methods.name: QueueAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with an activity context and sets an empty list of QueueItems.

methods.name: setActiveQueueItemId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the active (currently playing) queue item to update its visual representation.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or recycles a list item view, populates it with QueueItem data, and updates the icon based on whether the item is active.
